summary: P1 closure: unify the residue-order AND adjacency contract on one evidence basis.

contract.ordering: Per-chain canonical _pos from a single basis: valid label_seq_id > source_order > residue number. _extract / get_sequential_residues use it.
contract.adjacency: _is_sequential requires (a) same chain, (b) _pos==_pos+1 (source-order consecutiveness), and (c) labelling-coordinate bases, numbering compatibility (same seq with distinct insertion codes, or seq+1 with the blank/insertion transition). label_seq_id basis encodes adjacency directly and is gap-sensitive.
contract.gap_handling: For label_seq_id basis a source gap (_pos jump >1) yields an explicit NOT_MEASURED for LAW-110 (never a favorable PASS). For source/residue-number bases, numbering incompatibility prevents pairing across a missing position.

1PPE_class_synthetic.before: alphabetical (seq, icode) sort re-paired 1A/1/2; LAW-110 fabricated gaps (false veto).
1PPE_class_synthetic.after: source-order traversal measures both peptide pairs (1A->1, 1->2), sample=2, observed=0, PASS.
1PPE_class_synthetic.sample_before_after: LAW-110 sample 0 (skipped) -> 2 (both measured); observed 0 in both but the pair set is now correct.

missing_position_1_3.before: numeric rule skipped the pair -> NOT_MEASURED.
missing_position_1_3.after: still NOT_MEASURED (numbering-incompatible; not paired), so no favorable zero is fabricated.

label_seq_id_gap_1_3.after: LAW-110 NOT_MEASURED with reason 'missing polymer positions' (gap-sensitive).

od07_coordinate_identity: Unchanged: compute_coordinate_hash sorts by atom identity attributes (not source_order); OD-07 identity.py untouched; invariance/parity tests pass.
real_fixtures: 1PPE / 5T4O real pinned structures are NOT included; the 1PPE-class reproduction is synthetic. Real-fixture verification remains open and requires reproducibly pinned source structures.
